Welcome to Evelina Hospital School
We are a truly unique school, based within Evelina London Children’s Hospital, providing education for inpatients from Early Years through to Post-16. Whether a child is with us for a few days or a longer period, we ensure that learning continues in a way that meets their individual needs.
I am incredibly proud to lead Evelina Hospital School and to witness the exceptional work that takes place here every day. Our values of Caring, Ambitious and Inclusive are at the heart of everything we do, shaping the high-quality education and support we provide. By working closely with families, healthcare professionals, home schools and the local authority, our dedicated staff ensure that each child’s learning journey continues during their time in hospital. Together, we create a nurturing environment where every pupil feels valued, supported and empowered to achieve their full potential, regardless of the challenges they may be facing.
I hope our website gives you an insight into our special school community and the important role we play in helping children and young people continue their education during their time in hospital.

About Us
We are a thriving school community that exists to educate children and young people who are patients at Evelina London Children’s Hospital
Our values
Caring
Ambitious
Inclusive
Inspections (Ofsted)
Governance
A message from our Chair of Governors
On behalf of the Governing Board, I am delighted to welcome you to Evelina Hospital School. It’s a great privilege to serve this exceptional community as Chair, where education is delivered with both compassion and ambition. From my first visit, I was struck by the unwavering dedication of our staff, the boundless energy of our pupils, and the passion our teachers bring to fostering a love of learning in every student.
As a Governing Board, we take immense pride in both our children and the school community, and we are committed to supporting the co
ntinued success of the school. We achieve this by driving the ongoing development and improvement of all aspects of school life. Our governors bring a wide range of expertise from various fields, including education, finance, law, business, and other areas, and collaborate through two key committees—Resources and Pastoral & Curriculum—to ensure strong leadership, effective resource management, high standards in teaching and safeguarding, and robust accountability for both educational and financial performance.
We work closely with Headteacher Ms. Hamilton and her team to uphold the school’s core values, ensuring that every child receives a meaningful and enriching education, regardless of the nature or duration of their hospital stay.
I am deeply grateful for the unwavering commitment of my fellow governors, as well as the dedication and hard work of our teaching and support staff at Evelina. Together, they tirelessly support the success and wellbeing of each student, empowering them to thrive in this unique environment and beyond.
If you have any questions or feedback, please contact the School Office.
